visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish hair in pigtails and a beige sweater leans over a glass terrarium filled with egg cartons and large, brown insects. A man in a tan utility vest stands next to her, gesturing with his hands. Behind them, an older man in a black hoodie and orange beanie watches with a curious expression. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the interior of the tank, showing two large, shiny Madagascar hissing cockroaches crawling slowly over grey egg-crate material. (3) The scene shifts to the older man in the orange beanie speaking directly to the camera in a wide museum-like hall with insect displays on the walls. He appears skeptical as the guide speaks. (4) The guide holds two large cockroaches on his open palm towards the camera. The woman and the older man react with varying degrees of apprehension and amusement. (5) Close-up on the woman's hand as a cockroach is placed on her palm; she has a slightly distressed but brave facial expression. (6) The older man attempts to touch or hold a cockroach, his face contorting in exaggerated disgust and fear. The lighting is bright and even throughout the indoor facility.
